Mina: Heads-up 10:30 PT today we're running an enablement survey backfill. Goal: reconcile enablement_survey_sent vs survey_response within 14 days, set a canonical enablement_status, add a 'renewal_risk:low_engagement' tag for suspect accounts, and mute outbound survey webhooks during the job. Dry-run first 500 accounts. ETA ~45m.
Sam: Clarify: will this send any emails or trigger the survey pipeline?
Mina: No sends. We're only writing admin flags/tags. We'll flip survey_notification.enabled=false at the runner level for the window to prevent any downstream dispatch.
Avery: Can you paste the dry-run query and a sample transformation so I can sanity-check?
Mina: Dry-run query below (returns account, owner, last_activity_days, survey_response):
```sql
SELECT a.account_id, a.owner_id, a.last_activity_at, coalesce(s.response, 'none') as survey_response, now() - a.last_activity_at AS inactivity
FROM accounts a
LEFT JOIN surveys s ON s.account_id = a.account_id AND s.survey_type = 'enablement' AND s.created_at >= now() - INTERVAL '30 days'
WHERE a.account_status = 'active'
  AND a.created_at < now() - INTERVAL '7 days'
ORDER BY inactivity DESC
LIMIT 500;
```
Mina: Transformation rules (dry-run will only preview):
- if survey_response != 'none' => enablement_status = 'responded'
- else if last_activity_at > now() - INTERVAL '14 days' => enablement_status = 'active_no_response'
- else => enablement_status = 'no_response' and tag 'renewal_risk:low_engagement'
Sam: Add guard: skip accounts where opt_out_surveys = true OR renewal_status = 'renewed'. Also ensure we don't overwrite manual_enablement_status.
Mina: Added guards. Mutation pseudocode: 
```sql
-- snapshot first
CREATE TABLE cs_admin.backups.enablement_1756123456 AS
SELECT account_id, enablement_status, tags, updated_at FROM accounts WHERE account_id IN (<batch>);
-- update rows (actual run uses per-owner batches)
UPDATE accounts SET enablement_status = <new_status>, tags = array_union(tags, ['renewal_risk:low_engagement']), updated_at = now()
WHERE account_id = <id> AND manual_enablement_status IS NULL AND opt_out_surveys = false AND renewal_status != 'renewed';
```
Priya: Rollback plan? If we see noise we need to revert quickly.
Mina: Rollback: apply reverse updates from cs_admin.backups.enablement_1756123456; we also upload a CSV to admin S3 with changed ids and timestamped git diff of migration scripts. We'll keep detailed changelog in cs-admin/logs/enablement_backfill_1756123456.log.
cs-bot: Task created 1 CS-8401: "Enablement survey backfill + webhook mute" assigned to Mina. Window 10:30-11:15 PT.
Sam: Can you schedule the webhook mute on the runner? I can flip the feature flag for the window. Also please post a start + end marker here so infra can correlate.
Mina: Thanks @Sam. Plan: dry-run 10:30-10:40, write batches 10:40-10:55, verification 10:55-11:05, revert mute 11:15. I'll post start/finish and a short summary of counts changed. :white_check_mark:
Avery: I'll watch playbook fire-rate, webhook queue length, and support ticket spikes. Ping if >50 changes/min or any unexpected webhook spikes.
Priya: lgtm, thanks for adding guards.
Mina: Kicking off dry-run in ~5m. Will paste sample output when it's done.
